### BRANCH COVERAGE FIX: Empty List Test Case
**What we'll do:** • Add the missing empty list test case to achieve 100% branch coverage • Fix a typo in the test method (`.andExpected` → `.andExpect`) • Verify coverage completion through build and JaCoCo report
## Step 1: Open the Test File
```powershell code "order-service/src/test/java/com/fooddelivery/order/controller/OrderControllerBranchTest.java" ```
## Step 2: Add the Missing Test Method
Add this test method to the `OrderControllerBranchTest` class:
```java @Test void createOrder_EmptyItemsList_ShouldTriggerElseBranch() throws Exception { // items exists but empty → triggers else branch OrderRequest request = new OrderRequest(); request.setUserId(100L); request.setRestaurantId(200L); request.setDeliveryAddress("123 Main St"); request.setItems(new ArrayList<>()); // ✅ EMPTY LIST
Order saved = new Order(); saved.setId(1L); saved.setUserId(100L); saved.setRestaurantId(200L); saved.setStatus(OrderStatus.CREATED); saved.setTotalAmount(BigDecimal.ZERO); saved.setCreatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());
when(orderService.createOrderFromEntity(any(Order.class))) .thenReturn(saved);
mockMvc.perform(post("/api/orders") .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON) .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(request))) .andExpect(status().isCreated()); // Fixed typo: andExpected → andExpect } ```
## Step 3: Verify File Contents
```powershell Get-Content "order-service/src/test/java/com/fooddelivery/order/controller/OrderControllerBranchTest.java" | Select-Object -Last 20 ```
## Step 4: Build and Run Tests
```powershell mvn clean verify -rf :order-service ```
## Step 5: Check Coverage Report
```powershell Invoke-Item "order-service/target/site/jacoco/index.html" ```
---
### Key Implementation Details
**Branch Logic Targeted:** - The condition `order.getOrderItems() != null && !order.getOrderItems().isEmpty()` has three scenarios: 1. `items == null` → false (already covered) 2. `items != null && !items.isEmpty()` → true (already covered) 3. `items != null && items.isEmpty()` → false (**this test covers this**)
**Critical Fix:** - Fixed `.andExpected()` typo to `.andExpect()` to prevent compilation errors - Used `new ArrayList<>()` specifically to create an empty but non-null list - Set `totalAmount` to `BigDecimal.ZERO` which aligns with empty order logic
**Coverage Impact:** This test will exercise the else branch when order items exist but are empty, completing the final missing branch and achieving 100% branch coverage for the `OrderController.createOrder()` method.
